_comment: Site changelog (changelog.html). Newest first. One entry = one user-visible change: short title, 1-4 short points, optional page link and screenshots — "shots": [...] (icons/changelog/*.webp, made by tools/changelog_shots.py). Categories: Patch Reader, Materials, Hero Lab, Dynamics, Site.

entries.title: Changelog page
items: This page: short notes on what changed on the site, by date and category
"Changelogs" tab renamed to Patches; the header no longer shows the latest version
The "NEW" badge and its popup on the main page are gone

entries.title: Tormentor as a reworked objective
items: How Tormentor works now is one description box; the only real addition (250 gold on death) stays a change
Unyielding Shield and Reflect: before/after cards with the real pre-7.38 tooltips and clickable formula tables (per death → per minute)
Alleviation shown as a new-ability card; Wisdom Runes removal gets its own subgroup above Shrines of Wisdom (New objective)

entries.title: Lifesteal as a reworked mechanic
items: Full Valve text restored, including the parts that were cut and a lost info note
The new rules read as one description box; examples keep Valve's own notes

entries.title: New items as cards, clearer item reworks
items: A new item reads top-down: price → bonuses → abilities (Orb of Frost)
Abyssal Blade: before/after properties line up, the Strength +10 → +26 buff is visible, new bonuses are marked NEW

entries.title: Lists in "?" popups
items: A popup with several lines is now a bulleted list, on every page

entries.title: Game-time formula tables
items: Values that grow with game time (Bounty Rune gold, Tormentor) open a table by minute
Neutral camps named as in game: Small / Medium / Large / Ancient

entries.title: Roshan and Tormentor pages
items: Shown like heroes: portrait, abilities, change history
Roshan sits in Unit Changes → Other, Tormentor opens from Structures

entries.title: Easier reading of patch pages
items: "New mechanic" label on a header instead of a NEW chip on every row
Click a "?" to pin it; nested Valve notes live in the row's "?"
150+ rows got a real tag instead of MISC across 7.38–7.41e

entries.title: Faster pages
items: Patch pages scroll smoothly (7.41: slowest frames 50 → 17 ms)
Lighter icons (WebP)

entries.title: Item slots and pickers
items: 6 item slots on hero pages
One item picker style everywhere (Hero Lab, hero pages)
Names in matrices and Hero Stats are clickable

entries.title: Unit Changes and Structures
items: Every neutral creep, summon and lane creep has a changes page
Index laid out like the in-game picker, by camp size
Structures page for towers, barracks and Tormentor

entries.title: New creeps as cards
items: A new creep gets a stat table and its abilities, not a bare list

entries.title: Faster matrices
items: Only visible rows are drawn; autocast animations pause off-screen

entries.title: Patch 7.38 added
items: The full global patch: 234 heroes, items and units, 1585 changes
Checked line by line against Valve's data

entries.title: Keyboard-friendly Hero Lab
items: Search and keyboard navigation in the item shop
Arrow-key navigation in a roomier hero picker

entries.title: Hero Changes and Item Changes
items: The whole history of every hero and item on one page
Filters by tag, ability and talent; links from every patch page header

entries.title: Weights mode
items: Each patch cell can show a weighted score: how much a patch really changed a hero or item
Switch with the gold weights button
